headline: Paisalo Digital profit rises 27% as Maharashtra Scooters revenue grows 9%
hook: Mixed quarterly performance for mid-cap firms
summary: Paisalo Digital reported a 27% increase in profit for the second quarter. Maharashtra Scooters saw its revenue climb by 9% during the same period. These results reflect individual performance metrics for the respective companies. Retail investors should assess these figures against the broader financial health and growth trajectory of the NBFC and automotive sectors.
why_it_matters: Stock price volatility likely for these specific mid-cap entities
winners_losers: Paisalo Digital gains / Maharashtra Scooters gains

headline: Bajaj Nivesh files unaudited Q3 and H1 results
hook: Unaudited results filed, investors await details
summary: Bajaj Nivesh Limited, previously Maharashtra Scooters Limited, submitted its unaudited financial results for the quarter and half-year ended 30 September 2026 to the exchange. The filing provides preliminary performance data ahead of the audited results. No financial figures were disclosed in the announcement. Shareholders and potential investors will review the numbers once audited results are released.

headline: Maharashtra Scooters amends its Articles and Memorandum of Association
summary: Maharashtra Scooters Limited has informed the stock exchange about an amendment to its Articles of Association and Memorandum of Association. The filing provides no specific details regarding the nature of the alterations made. Such procedural changes are standard corporate updates that do not directly alter the financial standing of the company. Indian retail investors hold no immediate operational consequence from this administrative filing.
why_it_matters: No direct impact on shareholder value from procedural amendments.

headline: Maharashtra Scooters officially changes its name to Bajaj Nivesh
hook: Maharashtra Scooters drops its historical vehicle name
summary: Maharashtra Scooters Limited has received a fresh certificate of incorporation from the Ministry of Corporate Affairs, officially changing its corporate name to Bajaj Nivesh Limited. The rename reflects the company's evolution from its manufacturing origins into an investment-focused entity within the Bajaj group. Shareholders in this listed entity will now hold shares under the new corporate identity. Retail investors should note this name change for all future trading and portfolio tracking.
why_it_matters: Update your watchlist with the new ticker name Bajaj Nivesh.
